aboutText:
After more than a decade in the sales industry and with a strong passion for programming, I redirected my career toward web development.

As a frontend developer, I transform ideas into functional, intuitive, and visually appealing digital solutions, writing clean and scalable code, always keeping user needs and goals in mind.

Passionate about challenges, I work with precision to achieve objectives and deliver value from the very first moment.
My goal? To create digital experiences that stand out for their design, performance, and usability.

skillsText:
Frontend developer with experience in modern web development technologies. I handle HTML, CSS, SCSS, JavaScript, Python, React, Vue.js, Node.js, and Express, developing dynamic and optimized applications. Also, I have knowledge in JWT, API REST, and SQLAlchemy/SQL, allowing me to create scalable and secure architectures.

I work with various libraries and frameworks to enhance frontend development, including Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS, Material UI, and Vuetify to design modern and responsive interfaces. Additionally, I have experience with Docker for environment management and application deployment.

I specialize in creating Single Page Applications (SPA) with a focus on performance, accessibility, and UX/UI. I always seek to optimize every detail of frontend development and explore new technologies to improve the quality of the final product.
